newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia November unemployment rises to 4.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia November unemployment rises to 4.5 pct.

text.p: Unemployment in Mongolia was 4.5 percent at end-November, up 14.3 percent from a year earlier, official statistics showed on Wednesday.
A total of 53,597 people were listed as jobless compared with 46,889 at the same time last year, the State Statistical Centre said.
The true jobless total was probably higher because many jobless Mongolians do not register with the government, the Centre said.
Of the registered unemployed, 49.4 percent were women compared with 52.1 percent at the end of November last year.
